'''Rentalles''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
Rentalles was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a landscape dotted by caves and hillocks, which also featured [[Forest/Legends|forests]], woodland, and rocky foothills. Among the rocky foothills was a cave utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a supply cache. The planet was home to [[Rentallian cairnhound]]s, a pack-hunting [[Species/Legends|species]] that made its dens in the planet's caves and hillocks.<ref name="SWMBC" />

==History==
Rentalles was the site of a passive [[Alliance listening post]] that was abandoned when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] placed a [[Imperial supply depot and garrison|supply depot and garrison]] in close proximity. Once the Imperial base was also abandoned, [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] sent a team, under the command of [[Hov Windell]], to investigate and retrieve the modulator unit of a [[hyperwave signal interceptor]] left behind during the Rebels' rushed evacuation. Both Rebel and Imperial forces were attacked by cairnhounds during the operation.<ref name="SWMBC" />
